Title: Doctors form accepts invalid email without domain and overlength phone number
Preconditions: User logged in as team40 and opened Doctors module with existing doctor record available (second row: test1).
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open https://team40.qaaerp.com 2. Login with ID team40 and password vASPFtSh4d 3. Navigate to Doctors module 4. Open second row doctor record (test1) 5. Click Edit 6. Enter Email as invalidemail (no domain/TLD) 7. Keep Phone value with more than 10 digits (existing overlength value visible) 8. Click Save.
Expected Result: System should block save and show validation errors: (a) email must include valid domain format, (b) phone should be limited to 10 digits maximum.
Actual Result: Application accepts invalid email value 'invalidemail' and retains overlength phone value '99999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999' after save attempt. No validation error message shown for either field.
Evidence: Screenshot: postqode-screenshots/screenshot-1783779979777.png; Live snapshot after Save shows Email='invalidemail' and overlength Phone persisted.
